question: An electron and a proton are moving with the same speed. Compare their de Broglie wavelengths and justify which one has the larger wavelength.

options.A: The proton has the larger wavelength because it has larger mass at the same speed.
options.B: Both have equal wavelength because their speeds are equal.
options.C: Their wavelengths cannot be compared because only electrons exhibit de Broglie waves.
options.D: For the same speed, $\lambda=\dfrac{h}{mv}$ gives $\lambda\propto\dfrac{1}{m}$. Since a proton is much more massive than an electron, the proton has a smaller wavelength and the electron has the larger wavelength.
